_: Luong 'xem diem AI tham khao roi cham tay de len' cua actor A2, hien thuc hoa usecase_gv_cham_va_nhan_xet_bai_nop (F5-27, F5-07). Nguon: prototype 09-layoutBase/Giao vien - Cham bai.dc.html + 01-rd/screens/teacher/instructor_grading.md muc 3 -- tab loc 'Cho cham'/'Da cham'/'Tat ca' (diem 3), bang co cot 'Diem AI' (diem 4), cot hanh dong 'Cham ngay' mo modal (diem 5), modal co o 'Diem (0-10)' + o 'Nhan xet' textarea + nut 'Huy'/'Luu diem' (diem 6).
_khong_goi_llm: KHONG co participant 'Nha cung cap LLM', va do la diem chinh xac quan trong: man nay DOC LAI bao cao JSON F5-07 da sinh san tu luong AI cua hoc vien (F5.1), khong tu goi model. Nguon: instructor_grading.md muc 2 -- 'Nguon cua diem quy doi la bao cao JSON co luoc do cua F5.1'.
_khong_ghi_de: Buoc 8 ghi ro 'khong doi trang thai bai nop': F5-27 chot diem AI 0-10 va diem cham tay la LOP THAM KHAO NOI BO cua giang vien, tach bach hoan toan khoi Pass/Fail chinh thuc cua bai nop va khoi diem ty le testcase F4-13 hien cho hoc vien. instructor_grading.md muc 3 diem 8 xac nhan prototype cung khong co phan tu nao goi y diem anh huong trang thai.
_khong_ve: KHONG ve the thong ke 'Yeu cau review' du prototype con no: instructor_grading.md muc 3 diem 2 da gach bo hang muc nay. Diem de doc 1-5 do AI tu cham (F5-05) la truong KHAC, khong phai diem quy doi thang 10 nay.
